mentions.name: Conciliatower
mentions.description: A browser-based WASM remake of SimTower, produced through a six-month rewrite with Claude Code that replicates the original game's functionality from a Ghidra decompilation of the binary, an AI-generated summary of the original source code, and the author's memory of the gameplay. No new art was created: players load their own original game binary, which on-page code parses to pull out the original assets, preserving the original look and feel.
mentions.problem: The original SimTower was too difficult to get running through emulation, preventing re-play of the game.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I had claude faithfully rewrite SimTower so I could play it in the browser:

https://kvetch.io/conciliatower

I wanted to re-play SimTower but found it too difficult to get running through emulation. Instead, I worked for 6 months with Claude Code on a complete rewrite, replicating all the functionality from a Ghidra decompilation of the binary, an AI-generated summary of the original source code and my memory of the gameplay. Then deployed it to the web as WASM.
I wanted the original feel of the game, so didn't create new art. Instead, you load an original binary you provide, and the on-page code parses it and pulls out the original assets.
mentions.author: jonahss
